sass_facts_note2: SASS of flash_attn_ext_vec<128,1,f16,f16,false> (nvdisasm via cuobjdump -sass): ZERO WARPSYNC in both buggy and fixed (3048 / 3064 text lines); only 3 BAR.SYNC (the post-loop __syncthreads); 65 SHFL; 9 STS; 26 LDS. PTX of the same kernel: bar.warp.sync -1 appears once in buggy (the L320 __syncwarp) and twice in fixed (plus the new end-of-loop one) but ptxas emitted no WARPSYNC for either, so the fixed SASS differs from the buggy one only in prologue scheduling (opcode-sequence diff confined to the first ~110 instructions); the L320 syncwarp and the fix's trailing syncwarp both vanish in SASS. D=64 q8_0 instance (the llamacpp-open-1 kernel): 2 WARPSYNC in both variants, identical positions: WARPSYNC 0xffffffff directly before the first BAR.SYNC (after the predicated STS of yq/yds in quantize_q8_1_to_shared, so it does not order those two stores against each other) and WARPSYNC R8 (variable mask) inside the CALLed butterfly-shuffle helper (WARPSYNC R8; SHFL.BFLY). PTX bar.warp.sync count there is 1 (buggy) vs 2 (fixed), SASS WARPSYNC count 2 vs 2, opcode sequences identical except one NOP position. Consequence for note 2: in the open-2 main-loop kernel (D=128 f16) no WARPSYNC separates the KQ write of iteration n+1 from the KQ read of iteration n in either build, so a detector that orders only via BAR.SYNC/BAR.RED/WARPSYNC has no edge there, in the buggy AND the fixed build.
